name: Tohari Ahmad
title: Prof. Ir. Tohari Ahmad, S.Kom, MIT, Ph.D
bio: Prof. Tohari founded and leads the Net-Centric Computing Laboratory, setting its research direction across mobile computing, distributed systems, and network security. He supervises graduate research and represents the lab within the Department of Informatics Engineering.

name: Hudan Studiawan
title: Hudan Studiawan, S.Kom, M.Kom, Ph.D
bio: Hudan's research centers on digital forensics and log analysis, and he supervises the lab's forensics-track student projects. He also teaches network security courses in the department's undergraduate program.

name: Ary Mazharuddin Shiddiqi
title: Prof. Ary Mazharuddin Shiddiqi, S.Kom, M.Comp.Sc, Ph.D
bio: Prof. Ary works on distributed systems and cloud computing, guiding several of the lab's infrastructure-focused research tracks. He has published widely on system reliability and large-scale data processing.

name: Bagus Jati Santoso
title: Bagus Jati Santoso, S.Kom, M.Kom, Ph.D
bio: Bagus focuses on multimedia networks and pervasive computing, and mentors student teams building the lab's IoT and sensor-network projects. He also coordinates several of the lab's industry collaborations.

name: Moch. Nafkhan Alzamzami
title: Moch. Nafkhan Alzamzami, S.Kom, M.Kom
bio: Nafkhan supports the lab's mobile computing research and works closely with newer student generations on their first research projects, bridging coursework and hands-on lab work.
